block.savannahcat.food_water_bowl: Savannah Cat Food and Water Bowl
jei.savannahcat.bowl.contents: Use an accepted food on the bowl to add one item, or a water bottle to add one water serving. Water buckets fill the water section when enabled. In Survival, empty bottles and buckets are returned.
jei.savannahcat.bowl.food: Food must be edible and allowed by the server's healing-food list. The bowl holds one food type, up to 16 items, and up to 8 water servings. Refilling and visits must be enabled on the server.
jei.savannahcat.bowl.ownership: A bowl placed or claimed by you is reserved for your cats. Its contents are optional comfort, not a survival requirement. Crouch-use with an empty hand or a whistle to assign home to your nearest owned cat in range.
jei.savannahcat.cat.family: Crouch-feed raw cod or raw salmon to safe, fully healthy adults for breeding, or to your kitten to help it grow. These interactions follow server settings and cooldowns. Only the owner can feed a tamed cat for breeding or growth; cats belonging to different players cannot breed.
jei.savannahcat.cat.healing: When healing is enabled, feed an injured cat you own a food from the server's healing-food list. Healing takes priority over breeding. Crouch-feed a Downed cat you own an accepted healing food to revive it before its rescue time expires.
jei.savannahcat.cat.taming: When taming is enabled, feed a wild Savannah Cat an item from the server's taming-food list. Taming may take several attempts. These food settings can differ between servers.
jei.savannahcat.post.home: Crouch-use the post with an empty hand or a whistle to assign it as home for your nearest owned cat in range. Home assignment must be enabled on the server.
jei.savannahcat.post.use: Place the post in a safe area near your cats. Owned cats may approach and scratch it when free to relax; furniture activities follow server settings.
jei.savannahcat.whistle.controls: Crouch-use the whistle in the air to cycle Follow, Stay, Hunt, Harvest and Recall. Use it normally to issue the selected order.
jei.savannahcat.whistle.limits: Commands respect server settings, safety rules and range limits. Kittens cannot Hunt or Harvest.
jei.savannahcat.whistle.targets: Aim at a cat you own for an individual order. Otherwise the selected mode chooses eligible owned companions. Recall cannot reach cats in unloaded chunks.
